description: Instagram without Reels, feed or ads: an open-source, updatable Instagram app for Android that keeps DMs and stories.

latest_release.name: FeurStagram v454-0-0-54-77
latest_release.body:
Updated to Instagram 454.0.0.54.77, with a much more reliable Quoicouview mode, tablet support and a Notes block that works on every account.

## ✨ New
- **Following feed only joins the Permanent lock.** Once it is on and locked, the ranked feed can't come back without reinstalling.

## 🐛 Fixes
- **Stories in Quoicouview mode.** The stories tray now shows up every time, including when Instagram gives your account a different layout or when the app opens from a notification or a link. This also fixes a crash that could happen on the first launch after an update.
- **Notifications bubble in Quoicouview mode.** The red bubble under the heart no longer stays stuck and misplaced. The red dot still shows unread notifications.
- **Notes block.** Blocking Notes now works on the accounts where the Notes stayed visible.
- **Tablets and large screens.** The settings open again on a long press, and Home is hidden properly in Quoicouview mode. In that mode, long-press Messages to open them.

## 🔧 Under the hood
- **Instagram 454.** Updated to Instagram 454.0.0.54.77, keeping the existing blocks and settings. The APK is also much smaller, about 160 MB.
